posts.description: I'm exhausted today. posts.description: Politics here in the UK is wild right now. The last general election resulted in a landslide victory for Labour, not because everyone suddenly loved the Labour Party (they remain profoundly unpopular) but rather the country had finally woken up to the reality that the Tories are a bunch of terrible people and wanted to punish them for being who they are.
